scope_md:
We'll set up a Missed-Call AI Receptionist for your HVAC business. You keep your current business number and forward unanswered calls to a new US AI line we provision. When you're on a job and can't pick up, the AI answers. Automatic text-back to callers who hang up is coming soon, after US carrier registration.

The receptionist collects the caller's name, callback number, service address or ZIP, the type of HVAC job, how urgent it is and their preferred time. It is set up for your service area (77002, 77005 and Houston Heights) and can book appointments directly into your Google Calendar. Because you prefer not to quote prices over the phone, the AI will not give pricing and will take the details for you to follow up instead.

After hours, the line runs in after-hours mode instead of sending callers to voicemail. Emergency keywords, such as no cooling, no heat or a gas smell, trigger an immediate alert to you. You'll get an email for every lead, plus a daily summary email (text alerts too, once business texting is live). We'll load up to 25 FAQ entries along with your business hours.

You'll have a client portal with your call log, transcripts, bookings and settings. When US carrier registration for business texting opens, we file it for you. Each month we monitor the line, update prompts and FAQs as needed, and handle small change requests one at a time. A Zapier webhook is also available if you want to connect another tool later.
assumptions: One location and one AI line.
Your current phone carrier supports forwarding unanswered or busy calls to the AI line.
Appointments are booked into a single Google Calendar that you give us access to.
The AI will not quote prices; pricing questions are captured as leads for you to follow up.
The line operates in English only.
You will provide your FAQ content, business hours and the list of emergency situations you want flagged.
Your business details are available for US carrier registration for business texting, once it opens.
timeline_text: Your receptionist will be live within 10 business days after you complete the access checklist, which fits comfortably within your one-month timeline.

includes.name: Missed-Call AI Receptionist
list: 1 location and 1 new US phone number for your AI receptionist. You keep your own number; calls you miss are sent to the new one.
Answers the calls you miss (automatic text-back to callers who hang up is coming soon, after US carrier registration)
Collects job details: name, callback number, service address/ZIP, job type, urgency, preferred time
Booking into 1 calendar: Google Calendar or Calendly
Appointment manager: callers can check, move or cancel a visit it booked for them just by calling back, and it recognizes returning callers
Answers to up to 25 common questions, your business hours, a nights-and-weekends mode, and emergency words that alert you right away
An email alert for every lead, plus a daily summary email (text alerts too, once business texting is live)
1 Zapier link (Zapier is an app that connects apps) that sends each new lead and booking to any other tool
English only. Your own online account shows every call, a written copy of each conversation, your bookings and settings.
When US carrier registration for business texting opens, we register your business for you (fees included)

Included usage per month: 400 voice minutes (and 1,000 texts once business texting is live); we alert you at 80% and 100%; we never charge for extra minutes or texts on our own, we add more only if you say yes
Every month: we check that it works, update its answers, and make small changes for you, one at a time (up to 1 hour each)

excludes: Outbound AI calls and marketing text messages
After-hours dispatch that puts urgent calls through to your on-call tech (extra, fixed price)
More locations or phone numbers (extra, fixed price)
Spanish / bilingual phone line (extra, fixed price)
A direct link to apps like Jobber or HubSpot (extra, fixed price)
Chat box on your website (extra, fixed price)
Usage above the included 400 minutes (and 1,000 texts, once business texting is live); we alert you at 80% and 100% and add more only if you say yes
Call recordings (we keep a written copy of each call, not the audio)
Medical records or patient health information (we can't sign a HIPAA agreement)
not_included_extra: Dispatching technicians or deciding in real time whether to send someone out; the AI collects details and alerts you.

refund.guarantee: 30-day satisfaction guarantee: not happy within 30 days of go-live (the day it starts answering real customers)? We refund the setup fee for your AI assistant and turn it off. On the bundle, we refund only the AI assistant's part of the setup fee, and you keep the website. Monthly fees you already used are not refunded.
refund.deposit: Changed your mind? Ask within 7 days of paying and we refund your full deposit, as long as you haven't finished the setup checklist.
